content:
amanda: Heads-up: We’re cutting over GitHub Actions to OIDC-based auth and enabling the new Jira user-sync pipeline this Friday 09:00-11:00 PT. This is a planned migration to remove long-lived secrets from repo settings and to standardize SSO group mappings. Please read the checklist below and flag blockers.

mike: +1. Is there a hard cutoff for old secrets?

amanda: Old repo secrets will be allowed for 48h after the window for emergency rollback, then revoked. We’ll post a list of repos we touch.

lisa: What do app owners need to do?

amanda: Two small actions for each repo: 1) update GH Actions workflows to use OIDC tokens (see snippet), 2) remove any `ACTIONS_DEPLOY_KEY` PATs once confirmed. We’ll provide PR templates.

ada: Can you paste the Actions snippet?

amanda: Sure — use the short form and request `id-token`:
```yaml
- name: Request OIDC token
  uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Configure OIDC
  run: |
    echo "REQUEST_TOKEN=true"
  with: {}
- name: deploy
  uses: some-org/deploy-action@v2
  with:
    id-token: ${{ steps.oidc.outputs.token }}
```

jeff: For infra repos where we use self-hosted runners, anything special?

amanda: Self-hosted runners keep working but they need the `GITHUB_ACTIONS` metadata updated to request OIDC. We’ll patch runner images via bake; most owners just need to pick up the new AMI/container after the window.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] bake pipeline queued for runner image update across `runners-prod` pool — ETA 09:10 PT.

sre-oncall: During the window we’ll throttle non-critical deploys and set a temporary circuit-breaker on cross-region canaries. If any job hits OIDC errors, please slack `#eng-oncall`.

security-bot: [security-bot] Reminder: Jira user-sync will add group mappings for SSO->Jira. If you rely on custom group perms, file a ticket to `#eng-platform` before Thursday COB so we can include it in the sync mapping.

mike: How will we rollback if OIDC causes widespread CI failures?

amanda: Rollback plan: 1) re-enable repo secrets via admin rollback script (takes ~2m per org), 2) revert runner image to prior tag (automated), 3) open an org-wide pause on workflows via `org.settings.workflows.pause=true`. We’ll run a canary on a few low-risk repos 30m before wide cutover.

lisa: ETA on the repo list you mentioned?

amanda: Posting the repo list to this thread and a Google Sheet in 30m. Owners will be @mentioned.

ada: Will this affect the Jira import/issue linking?

amanda: Jira user-sync is separate but timed alongside this cutover to ensure permissions alignment. No content import; only identity mapping changes. Links remain intact.

jeff: Any SLA changes or support channels during the window?

amanda: Support: Pager for incidents, `#eng-platform` for coordination, and the escalation oncall (cc @sre-oncall). We’ll have a dedicated meeting room at 09:00 PT, calendar invite sent.

mike: Thanks — I’ll get my repos updated and open tickets for a couple of custom groups.

amanda: Thank you everyone — please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve read this and DM me blockers. We’ll post a brief postmortem if anything unexpected happens.
